trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.hint: starts a run when an event arrives

rule.label: Rule
rule.hint: evaluate a rule from the rule system

tool.label: Tool
tool.hint: call a tool (reads auto, writes through policy)

agent.label: Agent step
agent.hint: run a playbook / bounded LLM task

approval.label: Approval
approval.hint: ask a role; the run waits

task.label: Task
task.hint: create a task for a role

wait.label: Wait for event
wait.hint: pause until an event with the same key arrives
